project_info.theme: Career tribute through a monochrome portrait photo-grid mosaic
project_info.color_palette: Off-white, black, gray, selective team or flag colors, restrained metallic accents

main_subject.detail: A large high-contrast black-and-white portrait silhouette of [PERSON NAME], whose head and torso are filled with a dense career-action photo mosaic.
main_subject.style: High-end sports editorial, dual-exposure composite, tactile halftone, fabric, film-grain, and paper textures

composition_elements.type: Photo mosaic, micro-branding, and textured paper
items: Center: perfectly aligned large portrait silhouette acting as the vessel for small career images.
Inside silhouette: dense photo-grid of action shots; selective cells use halftone dots, canvas or embroidery texture, and heavy film grain.
Top left: [PERSON NAME] in small Inter Semibold type with tight negative kerning, no wider than 20% of canvas.
Top right: a very small approved team, brand, or flag symbol, no wider than 10% of canvas.
Background: off-white or pale gray paper or concrete texture with generous negative space.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Hard black-white contrast, tactile printed texture, restrained selective color rhythm, subtle aged paper grain

technical_specs.render_style: Mixed-media editorial collage and premium sports graphic design
technical_specs.resolution: 8k resolution, highly detailed, square social poster

assets.name: [PERSON NAME] portrait reference

assets.name: Career action-photo archive
assets.source: licensed editorial, team, or rights-holder imagery

assets.name: Team, brand, or flag symbol
assets.usage: Use only as the small upper-right symbol.

assets.name: Mosaic tribute layout
assets.usage: Match micro-scaling, negative space, rounded card edges, and grid density.

prompt_instructions: Attach cleared likeness, archive photo, and logo assets for a real person.
If no rights are available, use a fictional athlete or artist with original imagery and marks.
Do not enlarge the name or logo beyond the prescribed micro-scale.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [ PERSON NAME ]. Act as a high-end sports graphic designer creating a conceptual tribute poster. The style is a complex 'dual exposure photo-grid composite' with mixed-media textures. CENTRAL STRUCTURE (THE VESSEL): The central focus is a large-scale, high-contrast black and white portrait silhouette of [ PERSON NAME ]. This main portrait acts as the container. THE GRID FILL & TEXTURES (MIXED MEDIA): The interior of the silhouette is populated by a dense 'photo mosaic grid' of action shots from the person's career. CRITICAL TEXTURE INSTRUCTION: Do not just paste flat photos. Apply artistic textures to various grid cells to create a tactile, collage feel. Use effects like Halftone Dots, Fabric/Embroidery, and Film Grain. COLOR STRATEGY: The base is Monochrome B&W. Use selective color overlays relevant to the team or flag only on specific grid cells. TYPOGRAPHY & BRANDING (STRICT MICRO-SCALING): Top Left, write '[PERSON NAME]' strictly using Inter Semibold, tight negative kerning (-4%), small and discreet, maximum 20% of canvas width. Top Right, place the primary Team/Brand/Flag logo, very small, maximum 10% of canvas width. COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND: Use an off-white or light grey background with visible high-quality paper or concrete texture, center the figure perfectly, and maintain wide negative space.
prompt.negative_prompt: flat pasted photos, oversized name, oversized logo, colorful full image, glossy digital white background, distorted likeness, illegible type, watermark, signature
